  "rationale": "A self-employed marketing consultant, new to Zoho CRM (less than 6 months), relies heavily on setting up automated email workflows as a core function. While Zoho CRM is powerful, its extensive feature set can lead to a steeper learning curve, especially for advanced automations like workflows, which might feel overwhelming for a single user without dedicated technical support. This user would prioritize quick setup and intuitive configuration to maximize efficiency. The complexity of Zoho's workflow builder, combined with the general initial setup for a new user, suggests a moderate to slightly difficult experience, leaning towards a 2 or 3 (Neutral/Somewhat Difficult) rather than a very easy one."
